changes: Common order, carrier, commission, finance and account events have explanatory Turkish labels while retaining their exact source codes.
Audit Excel exports include both the human-readable action and original code; page, filter and business-time context are preserved.
Commission rule and earning entity types have explicit labels and exact quick filters.
Unknown action codes remain unclassified rather than receiving an inferred meaning. Prototype-like codes, entity types and roles cannot resolve to inherited object functions.
Audit metadata and private details remain excluded from rendered content.

verification.unit: audit-labels.test.ts passed two tests for known actions, frozen labels and unknown/prototype-like codes.
verification.handlers: verify-audit-workspace.cjs passed dates, stale responses, malformed data and exact-code exports, including a Turkish commission label alongside the original code.
verification.markup: verify-audit-view.cjs passed Turkish labels, exact codes, unknown values, metadata exclusion and stale/failed export controls. Browser layout remains unverified.
